Cash Value Mortality, Interest 
and Functions 
The cash value basis is bracketed to allow for changes for new issues in  
the future; currently the interest rate is 3.75%; any changes to mortality or  
interest will comply with applicable nonforfeiture law requirements and can  
only be made with prior approval.
